cross_cutting_findings: HMM historical smoothed probabilities use later observations inside fitted window; do not treat historical chart as causal signal. Endpoint probabilities in a truly trailing fit are not automatically future-leaking; fit cutoff and state ordering still require audit.
Low volatility does not imply positive return or low forward loss probability.
Market-context classifier, conditional policy and instrument return predictor require distinct output contracts.
No new profitability or performance reproduction claim.
